Experiences, reimagined

Turn the destination into part of the experience.

A great conference, retreat, festival, or group trip doesn't stop when the official programming ends.

Softer Strategies helps experience-driven brands connect the entire journey — official programming, destination discovery, hospitality, partner activations, exclusive perks, and the moments guests create for themselves.

We combine experience strategy, thoughtful curation, technology, content, and audience intelligence to make the experience easier to navigate and more valuable to everyone involved.

We build our own, too.

We didn't learn this from a slide deck.

Soft Queer Wealth
Independent sister media + community company

Soft Queer Wealth is a sister company to Softer Strategies — and one of our favorite testing grounds.

Built from the ground up, Soft Queer Wealth has grown from community storytelling into a Black queer media and community brand spanning original content, partnerships, cultural experiences, and digital products.

That work helped inspire The Mahogany Pages — a mobile-first discovery experience designed to help Black queer communities navigate events, businesses, travel, and culture.

The Mahogany Pages taught us something simple:

People value having everything they need in one trusted place.

And organizers benefit from understanding what people actually engage with.

That insight now informs how Softer Strategies thinks about conferences, travel, festivals, retreats, and destination experiences.

The Mahogany Pages, in the field

A digital concierge for the weekends that matter.

In its first six months, The Mahogany Pages has helped people navigate Black queer event weekends across the country — the parties, panels, brunches, and community gatherings happening all at once.

Events curated by and for Black queer women often get lost in the noise of Pride season, without the marketing or visibility they deserve. We put them front and center.

  • Global Black Pride
  • DC Black Pride
  • Capital Pride
  • Baltimore Black Pride
  • ATL Black Pride
  • Atlanta Pride
  • The Collective: Black Queer Takeover NYC
  • STAMINA Queer Caribbean Festival
  • Spelman Homecoming
  • Morgan Homecoming

One event weekend, by the numbers

2K+People navigated the weekend with our digital concierge
50K+Views on our posts that weekend
10K+Shares, saves, and comments

Six months in, and we're just getting started.

  • A community listConnecting our audience across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and The Mahogany Pages so we can reach people directly.
  • A queer promoter collectiveA growing circle of promoters who cross-promote: we amplify their events, and they share the digital concierge with their communities.

The softer method

Soft doesn't mean slow. It means it lasts.

Our methodology keeps big ideas manageable and sustainable — paced so the work doesn't burn you (or us) out, but disciplined enough to keep moving. It's a repeatable strategy we know works, because we tried it on ourselves first.

  • Sustainable

    Built to prevent burnout.

    Realistic pacing and clear priorities, so the strategy fits into your life instead of taking it over.

  • Agile

    Short cycles, steady progress.

    We borrow from agile frameworks: ship in small steps, learn quickly, and adjust without starting over.

  • Proven

    Tested on ourselves.

    The same process grew Soft Queer Wealth and The Mahogany Pages, so it's repeatable, not theoretical.

  • Data-led

    A little scientific.

    We observe, iterate, review feedback, and observe again, letting real behavior guide the next move.

Even your social media is a product — living, breathing, curated with grace, and checked down to the details before it goes out.

How a project moves

  1. Discover

    Understand the business, audience, and opportunity.

  2. Ideate

    Determine what deserves to be built.

  3. Execute

    Bring the strategy into the world.

  4. Reiterate

    Learn from people, behavior, and feedback.

  5. Scale

    Invest more deeply in what works.

↺ Then we observe again. Every cycle makes the next one smarter.

Meet the founder

Hi, I'm Briana. I like making ideas make sense.

I'm a product strategist, brand builder, and founder of Softer Strategies.

My background sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, data, and storytelling.

That means I'm usually thinking about more than what something looks like. I'm thinking about how it works, who it's for, how people move through it, what we can learn from it, and where it can go next.

Through Soft Queer Wealth and The Mahogany Pages, I've helped turn an idea about helping queer people find their people into a growing media brand, community, and digital discovery product.

Softer Strategies brings that same product thinking to founders, executives, creators, event producers, travel brands, and experience-driven businesses.

I personally lead strategy and bring trusted creative and technical collaborators into the room when the vision calls for it.

— Briana
